articles.title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models

articles.title: DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation

articles.summary: 针对 On-Policy Distillation（OPD）目标函数局限于 token 局部对齐的缺陷，本文提出 DiffGate。该方法引入难度门控机制，根据样本难度动态调整教师监督权重，进一步减少了学生与教师模型间的训练测试不匹配。

articles.title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks

articles.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
